instructions:
1. Start on all fours with hands under shoulders.
2. Brace your core and keep a flat back.
3. Walk your hands forward to extend the body into a long reach.
4. Keep hips from sagging as you reach full extension.
5. Walk your hands back to the start.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your core braced to stop the lower back from arching.
2. Do not let the hips drop at full extension.
3. Move slowly and control the reach.
4. Breathe out as you extend forward.

instructions:
1. Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
2. Bend your elbows to about 90 degrees.
3. Drive your arms forward and back in a running rhythm.
4. Keep your core tight and shoulders relaxed.
5. Continue for the set time.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep elbows bent at about 90 degrees.
2. Drive from the shoulder, not the hands.
3. Keep your torso still and core braced.
4. Match a steady running cadence.

instructions:
1. Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart.
2. Let your arms hang relaxed at your sides.
3. Swing both arms across your body to one side.
4. Swing them back across to the other side.
5. Let your torso rotate slightly with each swing.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Let the torso rotate to engage the obliques.
2. Keep the swing smooth and controlled.
3. Keep your core braced throughout.
4. Keep your shoulders relaxed.

instructions:
1. Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
2. Let your arms hang at your sides.
3. Walk forward at an easy pace.
4. Swing your arms forward and back with each step.
5. Keep your shoulders relaxed and core tight.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Swing the arms naturally with each step.
2. Drive the movement from the shoulders.
3. Keep your torso upright and core braced.
4. Keep a steady walking pace.

instructions:
1. Lie on your back with knees bent and heels on the floor.
2. Place your hands behind your head, elbows wide.
3. Lift your chest and twist your torso, bringing one elbow toward the opposite knee.
4. Lower under control back to the floor.
5. Twist to the other side.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your lower back pressed into the floor.
2. Move slowly and avoid pulling on your neck.
3. Exhale as you twist, inhale as you lower.
4. Drive the rotation from your core, not your arms.
